instruction: Complete the model in the opened Autodesk Revit environment using its automation interfaces, then export it to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. Before starting the work, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is a small walk-in clinic with a waiting side and an exam side. The practice needs a secure records room tucked into the waiting side while keeping the exam room and outer walls undisturbed.
